scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/worker
scripts.test: npm run build -w apps/worker && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts apps/worker/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:worker: npm run build -w apps/worker && node --import tsx --test apps/worker/tests/*.test.ts
